svg.title: SayItLocally
svg.desc: A speech bubble sends glowing sound across rings of time; it settles as words written on a translucent page: the developer's own record to verify the past and guide the future, kept on their machine, never shared.

g.text: Your words: verify the past, guide the future — kept private.
說出重要的話，留作自己的紀錄：驗證過去，指引未來，不外流。
